## Notes for the monitoring agent
- If uncertain about helical-pier applicability, set "Flagged for human approval" to yes and briefly explain the uncertainty.
- Research the exact alloy code(s) only when the incident is high priority or if the expected procurement will be impacted; otherwise, record candidate specs and defer.
- When adding sources, include stable URLs and a one-line summary for each.
- If this incident is local and time-sensitive (newsworthy), draft a short public-facing note that emphasizes the safety benefits and local investment, do not publish until human approval is received.
